Name: Luny's Salon - Short Hairstyles for Fashion Sense
Author: LooneyLuny
Description:
[img]https://i.imgur.com/3Ffvnd3.png[/img]

     Finally done with these! (ᗒ⩊ᗕ) I made these a while back, but I just couldn't stop making little tweaks here and there. There's technically 6 hairstyles in this pack, but they're all variations of each other. If you like one, you'll probably like the others too.

     I may add more later on, but for now I'm pretty happy with these. There aren't a lot, but I really like what's there. ^-^

     The butterfly rug in the images is from [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/28177]Prophet's Rugs[/url]. ♡ I really need to make a proper mod list to share...



     [url=https://ko-fi.com/looneyluny]Support me on Ko-fi[/url]﻿ or [url=https://x.com/LooneyLunyMods]follow me on X[/url]﻿ for updates and screenshots! (´꒳`)




[img]https://i.imgur.com/B92L7co.png[/img]

[center][b]Requires [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/9969]Fashion Sense[/url]﻿ to work![/b]
Download and unzip the file.
Move the folder "[FS] Luny's Salon - Short Hairstyles" into your StardewValley/mods folder.
Done![/center]
